job.title: RN Care Coordinator
job.description:
HealthPartners is hiring an RN Care Coordinator to support members with complex and chronic conditions across our primary care clinics.

Responsibilities:
- Coordinate care for a panel of members with chronic conditions such as heart failure, diabetes and COPD
- Complete assessments and build individualized care plans with patients and providers
- Manage transitions of care after hospital discharge, including follow-up calls within 48 hours
- Provide patient education on medications and self-management
- Connect members to community resources and social services
- Document in Epic and track quality measures

Requirements:
- Current Minnesota RN license
- BSN preferred
- 3+ years of clinical nursing experience
- Care coordination or case management experience preferred
- Strong communication and motivational interviewing skills
- Certified Case Manager (CCM) a plus

professionalSummary.summary: Registered nurse with 5 years on a 32-bed medical-surgical unit, focused on safe discharges and patient education.

achievements: Cared for 5 to 6 patients per shift on a 32-bed medical-surgical unit
Led discharge teaching for patients going home on new medications and wound care
Charge nurse 2 shifts a week, assigning patients and handling staffing gaps
Cut 30-day readmissions for heart failure patients on the unit by 12% as part of a discharge phone-call pilot
Precepted 9 new graduate nurses through orientation
Documented care in Epic and completed medication reconciliation on admission
Took vitals and helped patients with daily care on a 24-bed telemetry unit
Trained 4 new nursing assistants on unit routines
